title: mesh-bus service deployment adapter
description: Machine contract for installing, restarting, verifying, and rolling back a mesh-bus systemd service on a deployment host.

remote_ssh.description: SSH target used by ssh/scp, for example root@198.51.100.36.

remote_bin.description: Installed binary path on the remote host. Must match the target systemd service ExecStart binary.

remote_config.description: Installed runtime YAML config path on the remote host.

rollback.description: When true, restore the latest or explicitly supplied backup paths instead of deploying local artifacts.

preserve_remote_config.description: When true, do not upload local_config; preflight and restart with the existing remote_config.

rollback_bin.description: Optional remote binary backup path to restore.

rollback_config.description: Optional remote config backup path to restore.
